# Decks

<!-- Generated from the engine code by `make docs`: do not edit by hand. -->

The machine a game is played on (decks, in the original), chosen on the new
game screen: an advantage, sometimes a drawback.

| Id | Deck | Effect | Quip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `think_pad` | ThinkPad | +1 discard each blind | *The red nub sees everything.* |
| `framework` | Framework Laptop | +1 hand each blind | *Swap a module, play another hand.* |
| `basecamp` | Basecamp | Start with $10 more | *Calm money, in the bank.* |
| `raspberry_pi` | Raspberry Pi | +$2 per hand and +$1 per discard left at the end of each blind; no interest | *Frugal by design.* |
| `gaming_rig` | Gaming Rig | +1 joker slot, −1 hand each blind | *RGB sold separately.* |
| `omakase_install` | Omakase Install | Start with Clipboard Manager and 2 Up Arrow | *The chef already set it up.* |
| `theme_hopper` | Theme Hopper | Start with Theme Preview; −1 clipboard slot | *New theme every Tuesday.* |
| `board_member` | Board Member | Oligarchy cards show up in the shop; start with Restructuring | *Has a seat. Never attends.* |
| `mac_refugee` | Mac Refugee | Start with no face cards | *Left everything behind. Even the faces.* |
| `dual_boot` | Dual Boot | Start with 26 spades and 26 hearts | *Half Linux, half regret.* |
| `power_user` | Power User | Start with Shell Aliases, Theme Gallery and More Workspaces | *Dotfiles repo with 400 stars.* |
| `studio_display` | Studio Display | +2 hand size, −1 joker slot | *5K pixels. One port.* |
| `github_profile` | GitHub Profile | Gain badges: 2x after each boss | *Achievements unlocked. Twice.* |
| `hyprland_dwindle` | Hyprland Dwindle | Chips and mult are balanced when scoring; blinds are twice as big | *Perfectly balanced, as all splits should be.* |
| `live_usb` | Live USB | Every card's rank and suit is random | *Different every boot.* |
